title.zh-TW: 堆疊卡片捲動時掉落或甩出
title.en: Card stack fall or swipe on scroll

summary.zh-TW: 和「捲動時卡片堆疊」相反：一開始就是一疊卡片，往下捲時畫面先固定住，最上面的卡片一張張離場、後面的往前遞補；全部離場後頁面才真的開始捲動。上方可切換兩種離場方式：往下掉落，或左右交替甩出。往回捲會再疊回去。
summary.en: The reverse of “cards stack as you scroll”: it starts as a stack, the view stays pinned while the top cards leave one by one and the rest move forward; only then does the page actually scroll. Switch between two exits at the top: falling down, or swiping out left and right. Scroll back to restack them.

text.zh-TW: 把整個區塊固定在畫面上。固定的這段捲動距離拿來播掉落動畫，所以卡片沒掉完之前，頁面看起來不會往下走。
text.en: Pins the whole section. The pinned scroll distance drives the falling animation, so the page doesn’t appear to move until the cards are gone.

text.zh-TW: 每張卡片分到一段捲動距離（畫面高 × 0.6）。卡片越多，要捲越久才會掉完；寫成函式，視窗大小改變時會重新計算。
text.en: Each card gets a slice of scroll (0.6 × screen height), so more cards mean a longer pin. As a function it recalculates on resize.

text.zh-TW: 掉落用「一開始慢、越來越快」的 ease，像受重力影響；後面的卡片往前遞補則用 power2.out，快到位、慢慢停。
text.en: Falling uses an ease that starts slow and speeds up, like gravity; the cards behind move forward with power2.out, arriving quickly and settling.

text.zh-TW: 兩種離場方式寫成兩個函式，回傳「第 i 張卡片要動到哪裡」，其他（固定畫面、遞補）完全共用。甩出用 x 往左右交替飛出畫面（i % 2 決定方向），轉的角度比掉落大、不用淡出；切換時先把舊的 timeline 和 ScrollTrigger 拆掉再重建。
text.en: Each exit is a function that returns where card i should go; pinning and the move-forward are shared. Swipe flies cards out with x, alternating sides by i % 2, with more rotation and no fade. Switching kills the old timeline and its ScrollTrigger, then rebuilds.

text.zh-TW: 疊起來的樣子寫成一個函式：第幾張就往上錯開多少、縮小多少；變暗則是改卡片裡黑色遮罩（.shade）的透明度，不用 filter: brightness，捲動時才不會每一格重算整張卡片。前面的卡片掉落時，後面的每張都補到「前一格」的位置，看起來就像整疊往前遞補。
text.en: The stacked look is one function: each card sits a bit higher and smaller by its position. Darkening fades a black .shade layer instead of filter: brightness, so scrubbing doesn't re-filter whole cards every frame. When the top card falls, every card behind moves to the slot in front, so the whole pile advances.
